construct: Marginal versus average product at the MP–AP crossing
why: Only the key allows AP to change from rising to falling at the crossing. The alternatives have AP falling on both sides, rising on both sides, or zero on both sides; none can describe the stated crossing in the ordinary smooth production model. The missing alternative is a minimum, which would require inspecting crossing direction.
repair: Offer both an AP maximum and an AP minimum, each paired with a plausible observed ordering on either side of the marked labor input. Require that ordering from the figure and the marginal-average explanation.

construct: Close substitutes, elasticity and the total-revenue test
why: Only B consistently links more close substitutes to greater demand responsiveness and a revenue increase after a price cut in the elastic market. A and C mismatch those relationships; D equates an equal absolute price change with identical elasticity. The curve readings do not discriminate.
repair: Give two alternatives with the same correct substitute/elasticity/revenue relationship but different graph-derived interval elasticities or revenue totals. Retain the actual readings with a mistaken slope-versus-elasticity explanation.
